review.limitations: V2 nonblind AI_PROXY uses both actual finite sections and two per-pixel depth views of the identical geometry. Visual seat adoption is not indexed joining, global absence of intersection, an entire sealed boundary, or proof that all overhangs are valid. Two central cuts can miss off-plane features. No unique source-style requirement. Original painter-sorted V1 images and judgments remain unchanged and separately versioned.
review.notes: Depth rendering reveals C as the upper sitting surface of the cantilever chair rather than a gray-covered panel. The back base and front slab are organized around it, while a rear overhang and front-edge gap remain. Thin lifted or folded faces at the back cap are clearly visible and persist after postprocessing; these quality costs are separate from adoption.
review.prior_familiarity: True: previously reviewed these parents in earlier CREF and seat studies; current 12 pages were actually viewed independently without reading quality scores.
